rationale: The bid-ask spread of 155 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that requires a large move just to break even, making any entry unfavorable on a risk-adjusted basis. Price has already pulled back sharply from the session high of $17.90 to $17.39, sitting mid-range with no clear directional conviction — the last five candles show a spike up followed by a rapid reversal and choppy consolidation.
